thread:
Alex: Hey oncall team — heads up, my flight just got delayed, I won't be able to cover primary 22:00-02:00 UTC tonight. System is quiet now but marketing push may kick embeds traffic up around 23:00. Can someone swap? I can take 02:00-04:00 if that helps. If pager fires, follow the embed-backpressure runbook below and escalate per usual.
oncall-bot: Incidentbot: no active incidents. Current schedule shows primary: Alex 20:00-04:00 UTC. To reassign run: `/oncall transfer --from alex --to <name> --start 2026-03-15T22:00Z --end 2026-03-16T02:00Z` (see docs: https://redwood/internal/oncall)
Priya: I can pick up 22:00-00:00, but I have a doc review at midnight. @Miguel can you take 00:00-02:00?
Miguel: I can do 00:00-02:00. Quick q: do we want to pin traffic to `small-quant` variant if latency spikes? Auto-fallback exists but want to be explicit in the window.
Alex: thanks! @oncall-bot please start transfers once we confirm. Runbook: `embed-backpressure` https://redwood/runbooks/embed-backpressure — key steps: check embed queue length, flush KV cache, enable per-route caching, and toggle fallback model. Quick check command: ```sh # check embed queue length curl -sS https://telemetry.internal/api/queues | jq '.embeds' ```
Priya: ack — will post a short handoff note at 21:50 in this channel with checklist and telemetry links.
Priya: Handoff checklist I'll paste at 21:50: 1) certs/keys valid? 2) Dedicated pool health (gpu IDs + mem usage) 3) Canary warmup: `curl -H "Model: small-quant" https://api.redwood/v1/generate` 4) Confirm autoscale policy not throttled. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/primary-handoff
Miguel: ack, I'll monitor redis queue and the KV hit rate 22:45-02:15. If pager fires and doesn't clear within 2 minutes escalate to L2 @Jordan.
Jordan: I'll be L2 for the window. @Miguel DM me if you open an incident. I'll also watch compactor jobs and disk pressure.
oncall-bot: `/oncall transfer --from alex --to priya --start 2026-03-15T22:00Z --end 2026-03-16T00:00Z` — success. `/oncall transfer --from alex --to miguel --start 2026-03-16T00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T02:00Z` — pending confirmation (awaiting Miguel ack).
Alex: confirmed both swaps on my side. Thanks everyone — I'll update my calendar invite and add brief notes to the ticket.
Miguel: confirmed, oncall-bot transfer succeeded for my slot. Also adding a tiny troubleshooting snippet to the handoff notes: ```yaml checks:
  - name: embed_queue_len
    threshold: 500
  - name: hot_kv_cache
    action: flush-if-above
```
Priya: confirmed. I'll drop the telemetry dashboard links at 21:52 (embed latency, queue length, GPU util).
Alex: one more ops note — customer-impact: if embeds fail, use cached-embeds fallback (S3) via admin route: `POST https://admin.redwood/internal/fallback?route=embeds` and tag incident with `customer-impact:embeds`. Also annotate with `deployment:hosted` vs `dedicated` if it looks infra-specific.
Jordan: got it. I'll prep an S2 incident template for faster triage: https://redwood/incidents/s2-template — will add the escalation steps and who to loop for infra.
Priya: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll handover at 21:50 and ping when done.
Alex: appreciate it — see you all after the window.
__notes: thread follows on-call swap + surge watch pattern; contains runbook links, commands, and short, choppy messages as per Slack style
